messages:
sam: Heads-up — follow-up from last night's chat flakiness postmortem. We need clear owners, timelines, and a recurring detection rule. Short thread to assign and confirm next steps.
anya: Thanks. Major symptoms: timeouts at ~200ms request window, partial responses that require reconnects, client-side retries compounding load.
ops-bot: Incident #INC-2026 created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026 :rotating_light:
miguel: Proposed action items:
- A1: Fix reconnect backoff + client jitter (owner: miguel) — 2w ETA
- A2: Add server-side partial-response detection + auto-fill retry guard (owner: ryan) — 3w ETA
- A3: Alert rule for recurring partials > 0.5% per 5m (owner: anya) — 1w ETA
- A4: Runbook update + playbook checklist for oncall (owner: sam) — 3 days
ryan: Adding monitoring query for partial responses (Prometheus/ingest):
```promql
sum(rate(chat_stream_partial_responses_total[5m])) / sum(rate(chat_requests_total[5m])) * 100
```
Set alert when >0.5 for 5m and repeat 3 times.
product-amy: Thx. Need an external communications owner for any customer-facing outages > 30m. Volunteer: product-amy?
anya: I can own alert tuning and the initial investigation SOP. Will update the alert dashboard and add a dedicated graph.
miguel: For A1 (client backoff) I'll open two PRs: one to adjust default client SDK backoff and one for server-side handshake timeout increase with a flag. PRs: https://git.redwood/p/miguel/sdk-backoff and https://git.redwood/p/miguel/handshake-timeout
sam: Ownership noted. Can everyone drop their PR/issue links in the tracker doc by EOD? Link: https://docs.redwood/internal/incidents/INC-2026-followup
ryan: Also adding a synthetic test that simulates partial responses and measures recovery time. Will add to infra-e2e. ETA 10 days.
ops-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation for next two weeks assigned to @miguel (week 1) and @anya (week 2).
product-amy: We should also add a metric for "connected duration before partial" so we can spot regressions in reconnection loops.
anya: Agreed. Will add metric name: chat_stream_partial_window_ms and tag by model, route.
miguel: Recurring incident detection note: I'm going to create a Cron job that checks 30-day windows for >3 incidents with the same fingerprint (timeout+partial). If true, it will auto-create a medium-priority ticket for infra/review.
sam: That helps break the repeating pattern. Also let's make sure runbook has a checklist: 1) check KV cache warming, 2) check connection pool saturation, 3) check per-route timeout overrides.
ryan: Quick implementation snippet for client jitter (Node SDK):
```js
function backoff(attempt){
  const base = Math.min(1000, 50 * Math.pow(2, attempt));
  const jitter = Math.random() * 0.4; // 0-40%
  return Math.floor(base * (1 + jitter));
}
```
miguel: Timeline sanity check: A3 (alert) by next Wed, A4 (runbook) by Fri, A1 (backoff PRs) in 2 weeks, A2 (server detection) in 3 weeks, e2e synth in 10 days. If anyone needs reassign, say now.
anya: Can do alert + dashboard by Wed.
ryan: 10 days for e2e is fine.
product-amy: I'll hold external comms and draft a short postmortem summary once we have owners and ETA confirmed.
sam: Great. I'll track these in the weekly remediation board and ping during Thursday's infra sync. Please update the tracker doc with links and small PR checkboxes. :white_check_mark:
miguel: One more: adjust streaming server log level for partial responses to DEBUG for 72h after deploy so we can correlate traces. Will include a rollback plan.
ops-bot: Follow-up checklist created in INC-2026-followup doc. Next status update in 48h.
sam: Closing thread: everyone cc'd, thanks — aim to reduce partial/timeout incidents by 80% over the next month.
